metadata.description: Custom 3 - Station Dock Squatting: the only station has a single dock (capacity 1). Drive unit 0 delivers a pod, then becomes idle and is free to sit on the dock forever. While it squats, drive units 1 and 2 are inbound with more pods but cannot take the dock slot, so those pods score zero. An eviction protocol that immediately routes empty units away from a station is the only way to keep the dock turning over.
